title: Multiple revision canary, authorized preview and retirement
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Split multiple revisions and retire one; preview access and old-work gates remain necessary.

sourceContract.readme: S126 | Container Apps, multiple revisions: Demonstrate weighted canaries, controlled retirement, and compatible rollback.
sourceContract.backlog: D-S126 | Add a Container Apps multiple-revision preset for canary/preview/rollback/retirement.
sourceContract.acceptance: Native revisions and actual traffic are observed; preview routes stay authorized; old revision retirement follows verified gates.
sourceContract.portableCard: A-S126 | Split multiple revisions and retire one; preview access and old-work gates remain necessary.
sourceContract.nativeSibling: B-S126 | Conduct one multiple-revision preset; verify native routing, authorized preview, and controlled retirement.

documentedConstraints.multipleRevisions: Multiple mode allows several active immutable revisions, weighted ordinary ingress traffic and manual activation/deactivation.
documentedConstraints.trafficWeights: Traffic split rule weights must sum to 100%; a revision name or label can identify the destination.
documentedConstraints.previewLabels: A label selects only one revision at a time, can move while keeping its URL and works independently of ordinary weighted traffic, including at zero weight. A label URL is not an application authorization guarantee.
documentedConstraints.readinessQualification: The documented latestRevision readiness gate does not imply complete application readiness or all-user migration. This lesson separately measures fixed provisioning, ALL replica probes, dependencies, state and capacity observations.
documentedConstraints.retirementQualification: Manual deactivation is not evidence that old clients/work drained; application routing, state, ownership, artifacts and retention require separate verification.
documentedConstraints.rollbackQualification: An inactive revision can be activated on the platform, but readiness, capacity, retained artifacts and application state compatibility still need evidence. This bounded lesson cannot resurrect retired teaching DATA.
documentedConstraints.notSlotsOrScaling: ACA revisions are not App Service slots. A software-version or routing change does not prove a sustained compute-capacity increase.

preconditions: ALL revisions, software, weights, preview identities, readiness, routing, requests, work, state and retirement values are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
Three distinct immutable teaching records: fiction-old-r1/v1, fiction-canary-r2/v2, fiction-preview-r3/v3.
Ordinary baseline weights are 100/0/0; only fixed 80/20/0 and 0/100/0 selections exist.
Preview label DATA independently selects r3; selected login/callback and normal navigation plus visitor/non-selected paths must be observed.
Two bounded canary and three declared promotion transitions preserve identity/cart:3 and exactly one effect within the original 400 ms budget.
Old ordinary/direct/label admissions, sessions, requests, streams, jobs, ownership, checkpoints, state, effects, artifacts and retention are independent gates.
actions: Record exactly v2 and one fixed fixture without claiming readiness or migration.
Inspect readiness and measure selected/non-selected preview paths.
Record 80/20/0 desired weights; separately measure request identities, complete canary journeys and current preview authorization/navigation DATA.
After a positive canary, record 0/100/0; separately measure promotion and current preview DATA rather than reusing pre-split authorization.
Audit old routes/work/state and request teaching retirement only after every observed gate passes.
Inspect compatible rollback; retain earlier interruptions and unknowns.
Reset in-memory state, archiving prior run evidence without any file or resource operation.
assertions: Tokens, weights and successful probes do not certify readiness, authorized preview, migration, old-work drain or native ACA behavior.
Zero preview weight does not deny direct label access; selected login/callback and non-selected denial paths remain separate measured gates.

Every split invalidates the old preview result; measurements recheck current preview and production navigation. A post-promotion leak blocks retirement even when routing and all sampled journeys pass.
A configured zero old weight can coexist with a pinned old request/user or pending old work.
Current routing unknown is displayed separately from last known weights; old-only and unknown journeys never count as successful transitions.
Positive, negative and unknown outcomes, the full attempted denominator and failures before rollback remain recorded.
Retirement changes only the old teaching record; preview and canary remain active.
Fresh old readiness/capacity, compatible state and retained artifacts are required for rollback.
Strict exact typed commands and deterministic full-history state replay reject coercion, forgery, getters, hidden keys, symbols and cycles.
Twenty actions and twenty prior in-memory reset runs are retained without pruning; errors cannot mutate the current history.
Native keyboard, visible focus, alert/status, prototype reset and visible missing-model failure work; actual CSP blocks forbidden execution and navigation.

limits: No actual ACA, registry, resources, identity, configuration, deployment, IaC, scaffold, credentials, expenditure, packages, frameworks, downloads or unsafe browser flags.
Browser measurements observe the lesson's DOM and compute results from fixed fictional DATA; they are not actual platform or registry telemetry.
No live-native proof, all-real-users migration claim, production Node.js 24 validation, source-parent completion or five-nines result.
Published isolated helper has known unattended context/page/cleanup lifecycle limitations; inactive recovery prototype remains unqualified and unused.
B-S126 still needs CORE, DATA, ACA, C070 and an approved native target with independent observed routing, authorization, work/state and retirement evidence.
Parent alone accepts A-S126 once. Original frozen S unit only; tests, repairs, proof and refinements earn zero extra credits.
C005-C008 and local-harness integration are separately owned and untouched.
